Project Looking Glass 1.70.0

Released 2026-10-23 · GitHub release · CHANGELOG.md

1.70.0 — 2026-10-23 — Gradle / JDK 21 modernization

Added

  • "Install WBLFS (LG3D)" start-menu item (lg3d-core, src/etc/lg3d/startmenu.lgcfg) — A System-group StartMenuItemConfig that launches the Calamares installer with root privileges via pkexec calamares, using the generic system.png icon. It is a companion to the WBLFS installer integration and self-hides on a host where the launcher cannot run (see the availability fix below).

Fixed

  • A privilege-escalated start-menu item now self-hides when the elevated program is missing (lg3d-core, org.jdesktop.lg3d.scenemanager.config) — ApplicationDescription.isApplicationAvailable decided an item's visibility from the first token of its command only, so pkexec calamares was shown wherever pkexec existed even with no calamares installed — an item that dies when it is clicked. The decision is extracted into a new pure LaunchCommand: it still requires only the leading program for an ordinary command (so firefox https://… never mistakes its URL argument for a missing executable), but when that program is a privilege wrapper (pkexec, sudo, doas, gksu, gksudo, kdesu, kdesudo) the first following non-option token — the real program the wrapper elevates — is required too. Covered by LaunchCommandTest and the new launch-availability.feature Cucumber scenarios, and verified on a host with pkexec but no calamares (one variable changed: pkexec calamares → unavailable, pkexec sh → available, firefox https://… → still available).

The test reports of a published release are generated beside this page: <version>/reports/ carries the JUnit, JaCoCo, Cucumber and PIT mutation reports of every module with a test suite. Each module runs report-only (mutationThreshold = 0, no gate) unless it appears in the mutationExemptions map, where it is gated at the score its own suite really achieves. The same tree is attached to the GitHub release as reports-<version>.zip, so a report outlives a rebuilt site.
